2609.30121.title: What, When, and How: Audio Description as Constrained Global Optimization
2609.30121.paper_summary: Audio Description (AD) makes movies accessible to blind and visually impaired audiences by narrating visual information in gaps between dialogue. Existing automatic AD systems largely treat generation as a local video-to-text problem, assuming that the content to describe and its temporal location are already provided. Realistic AD instead requires coupled decisions about what visual information is narratively important, when it can be spoken without interfering with dialogue, and how it should be formulated to fit within the available time. We formalize AD generation as a constrained optimization problem over these three decisions. Our hybrid system uses large language models to propose and ground visual elements, estimate their salience to the narrative, and generate compressed realizations. A mixed-integer linear program then jointly selects and schedules descriptions across a scene subject to temporal constraints. When evaluated on REFRAMED, a benchmark for realistic AD of movies, our approach makes better decisions than prompted LLMs about what to describe and when to describe it, establishing a new SOTA on narrative QA and temporally grounded metrics. Ablations show that explicit temporal constraints drive gains in placement, while salience estimation controls how much narratively useful content is retained. Improvements are concentrated on temporal and narrative measures rather than n-gram overlap, although a significant gap to professional describers remains.
2609.30121.paper_summary_zh: 音頻描述（AD）透過在對話之間敘述視覺信息，使電影對盲人和視力受損的觀眾可及。現有的自動AD系統主要將生成視為一個局部的視頻到文本問題，假設要描述的內容及其時間位置已經提供。現實的AD則需要對哪些視覺信息在敘事上重要、何時可以在不干擾對話的情況下進行講述，以及如何在可用時間內進行表述做出綜合決策。我們將AD生成形式化為一個針對這三個決策的約束優化問題。我們的混合系統使用大型語言模型來提出和確定視覺元素，估計它們對敘事的重要性，並生成壓縮的實現。然後，混合整數線性規劃共同選擇並安排場景中的描述，並遵循時間約束。在對REFRAME的評估中，這是一個針對電影現實AD的基準，我們的方法在描述內容和描述時機的決策上，比提示的LLMs表現得更好，並在敘事QA和時間基準指標上建立了新的SOTA。消融實驗顯示，明確的時間約束推動了位置的提升，而重要性估計則控制了保留多少敘事上有用的內容。改進主要集中在時間和敘事指標上，而非n-gram重疊，儘管與專業描述者之間仍存在顯著差距。
